summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and Control.title(title) with a docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when the control is written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_console.py::test_set_window_title (skipped on win32 as an approximation of legacy Windows), test_control.py::test_control_title, and test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title (Windows only). Nothing was run, per instructions, and Black/mypy were not run, so formatting and typing are verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
